title: Recover sounding events from score images
hypothesis: An agent recognizes symbols but misconstructs simultaneity, accidental scope, sustained ties or repeated attacks in the sounding-event representation.
why_hard: Visible symbol relationships determine the exact event multiset. All images are visible and manual/OMR correction is legitimate; both models correctly reconstruct every event on this fixed task.
next_action: Retired after Sol/max and Astra/max both achieved exact 96/96 events and F1 1.00; preserve the fixed images and freeze.

sources.note: Brainstorm New Tasks, design message c360defc-431f-4eb3-926b-2bf1e633eb70; BR-002/D04. Retrieved prefix, not verified benchmark/model evidence.

notes: BR-002/D04: both natural runs pass; H-D04 unsupported. Four artifacts use two notation patterns across treble/bass. Sol took 849.882 agent seconds and Astra 195.167; one pair does not estimate a general speed or capability gap.
